exposure: Perinatal asphyxia (induced by 15-18 min umbilical cord occlusion)
outcome: Cerebellar cell density (internal granular layer and white matter)
cohort: Thirty-four term Macaca nemestrina macaques, including control animals and those subjected to perinatal asphyxia via umbilical cord occlusion, were studied.
finding: Animals with cerebral palsy demonstrated white-matter changes, histopathological changes in both white and gray matter, and brainstem injury correlating with CP severity, while the TH + Epo treatment group showed less brain pathology and no long-term neuropathological toxicity.
